name: a highlighted claim lands beside a funding stat
looks: A two-line claim settles with its last word boxed in a solid colour highlight, then beneath it a hairline divides to a large dollar figure with a short caption naming the round and the timeframe.
build: The highlighted word's background box scales in from the left (scaleX on a colour block) a beat after the text; the stat beneath rolls its digits up with data-infographic's vertical-blur count, landing on power3.out.
sound: A soft snap as the highlight lands, a rising tone under the number roll-up.
prompt: Land a short claim with its final word boxed in a solid colour highlight the instant it settles, then reveal a large number beneath it with a short caption giving it context (an amount, a timeframe). Let the highlight and the number be the only two accents in an otherwise plain layout.
